author: CharlZe
body:
Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) - CharlZe.
The reason you were temp-banned/banned - Banned for scamming.
Why you should be un-banned from the server. - I am deeply sorry for my actions and regret ever scamming your server.
Was my temp-ban or ban really false? - No my ban was not false and i accept the consequences for my actions.
Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? - No evidence as it was not false.
Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? - I have waited long enough to be un-banned as i was banned in July of 2015 which is an equivalent of 6 months.
Have I been caught ban evading? - No i have never been caught ban evading.
Have I appealed a ban before? - I have appealed a ban and it was accepted.

Regards CharlZe
